messages:
maria: Quick heads up — planning a small py/ts SDK canary publish in the 22:00-22:30 UTC change window tonight. Primary goal: ship bugfix for streaming + include deprecation note for legacy sync clients. deploy-bot will post status. @ben can you prep the changelog snippet? :eyes:
ben: on it. I’ll add a short ‘what to expect’ and the deprecation blurb. tagging the npm dist-tag plan.
sam: leaving a quick note — current e2e smoke on staging shows a token header mismatch on chunked responses. might block streaming tests.
andrew: thanks for the callout. CI ran earlier but flakiness possible; if deploy-bot marks canary failed we should hold the publish, not rollback the entire release train. prefer a canary holdback + pin older patch for critical customers.
deploy-bot: Starting canary publish for packages: @redwood/sdk-js@0.12.3-canary.1, @redwood/sdk-py==0.12.3rc1. Running publish-checks (signatures, dist-tags, wheel audit).
ci-bot: smoke-tests/staging — started. This will take ~3m.
sam: failing test: auth:chunked-header mismatch — stack: 
```
AssertionError: expected 'authorization' header to be 'Bearer <token>' but got 'Authorization: Bearer <token>\\n'
```
(and it only repros with python client when streaming with content-length omission)
maria: thanks. decision call: if smoke-tests fail due to streaming we'll hold the canary. we don't want to push a canary that regresses streaming. ben, mark the changelog with a note that streaming fix is in the next patch. devex-ops, please ensure enterprise pinning guidance is updated (how to pin to 0.12.2).
devex-ops: ack — will post a short pinned note in #product and update the docs page with `pip install redwood==0.12.2` and npm dist-tag instructions.
deploy-bot: Canary publish status: FAILED — smoke-tests/staging returned non-zero. See logs: http://ci.internal/build/1799954321/logs
ben: copy. will change dist-tag plan: do NOT tag canary as latest. keep canary dist-tag only. pushing release-notes draft to PR.
andrew: ops decision: holdback canary, do not rollback production. we'll re-run the canary next change window after a targeted test fix. For customers on dedicated infra, recommend pinning to 0.12.2 and enable explicit fallback to sync client until fix ships.
maria: +1. @sam can you file a mini PR with a focused test and a repro snippet? we want a green canary next try. also add a short paragraph to release-notes explaining why canary was held and how to pin. :handshake:
sam: filing PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/432 — includes repro and patch for header normalization.
ben: pushing the release-notes draft now and adding deprecation language for legacy sync client with timeline. will not publish npm `latest` or pip stable yet.
maria: closing loop — no rollback, canary held. reattempt scheduled for next change window (tomorrow 22:00 UTC) after CI fix. I’ll post a short summary in #eng-releases and update the change-log. Thanks folks. :rocket:
